summary: Frontend-only testing of GSAP intro + halftone hero. All 10 requested checks passed: fresh-session intro overlay with pill + Skip; 'Dhairya' letters at ~1.2s and 'Portfolio' at ~2.7s; overlay removed after ~3.6s with hero-title 'Portfolio' visible; sessionStorage introPlayed=1; Skip removes overlay immediately; reload in same session shows no intro; reduced-motion context skips intro and draws halftone; halftone canvas non-blank at 1920x800 (111969 px) and 390x844 (27394 px); hero has eyebrow, positioning, subline, 4 lavender buttons, no 'Dhairya' in hero-section; scroll locked during intro (scrollY 0 after wheel) and works after (scrollY 1500); timeline, museum exhibits (/museum-of-failures/1..4), skills, achievements, contact render; nav menu opens and scrolls to Skills; museum story btn navigates to /museum-of-failures/2; no console errors; no horizontal overflow on mobile.

issues: Portrait's photo background renders as a large dark diagonal triangle of dots on the left of the face (desktop and mobile); it competes with the face and on desktop sits close to hero copy. Consider masking the background / stronger radial falloff.
Mobile: halftone top edge runs under the nav pill and its bottom edge touches the top of the 'Portfolio' title.

action_items: Optional: Intro overlay root has aria-hidden='true' while containing the focusable Skip button (a11y violation: focusable content inside aria-hidden). Move aria-hidden to the decorative stage only.
Optional: refine halftone mask so photo background doesn't form a dark triangle.
critical_code_review_comments: Intro.jsx: aria-hidden on container hides the Skip button from assistive tech while still keyboard-focusable.
Intro.jsx: if document.fonts.ready never resolves (rare), page stays scroll-locked with overlay until Skip; consider a timeout fallback.
Halftone.jsx: resize handler only rebuilds when width changes (ok for mobile URL bar), fine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static frontend. Each new browser context = new session (intro plays). Use browser.new_context(reduced_motion='reduce') for RM test. Halftone pixel check via getImageData on [data-testid=hero-halftone] after ~2s post-intro.
